subject: GlasgowAI Sprint - community credits & trial extension request
message_1:
From: Elena Popov <elena@glasgowai.org>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: GlasgowAI Sprint - request for community credits

Hi Aisha,

Hope you're well — I'm reaching out from the Glasgow AI Collective where we run an annual two-day community sprint (Dec 10-11). We've run Redwood-backed mini-sprints in past years and the maintainers found the free compute and trial extensions extremely helpful for hack submissions and mentor demos.

This year we're scaling to ~120 participants and expect ~30 project teams. Would Redwood consider: 1) a pool of promo credits for open-source maintainers / student teams (approx 100k token-equivalent), and 2) a 30-day trial extension for projects that register as community-maintainers? We typically offer reciprocity in event materials and a small slot in the opening remarks.

Can share an organizer runbook and attendee breakdown if that helps. Happy to hop on a short call this week.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Popov
Program Lead, Glasgow AI Collective
organizers@glasgowai.org

--

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and thanks for the details. We love supporting community sprints like this. A couple quick Qs so we can scope it properly:

- Can you confirm the split between 'maintainers' (projects with upstream repos) and student/volunteer teams?
- Do any projects plan to use private datasets / on-prem infra?
- Are you requesting credits for hosted API usage, or would on-site dedicated capacity be needed for live demos?

I'm CC-ing Rishi (partnership credits) and Marcus (program ops). I'll leave the proposal numbers to them but we can do a provisional commitment quickly if everything looks good.

If it's easier, I can send over a short MOU template and a sponsor package for inclusion in your materials.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

Thanks Aisha / Elena — happy to support this. Provisional offer: 120k hosted API tokens in a promo pool and a 30-day trial extension for teams that register as community-maintainers (we'll validate via repo links). We'll also provide 10 mentor accounts with expanded rate limits for demo day.

Conditions:
- Credits are for non-commercial/open-source projects only.
- Promo codes will expire 90 days after issuance if not claimed.
- We require a short MOU confirming Redwood mention in event materials and a single slide in the opening.

I've attached our internal promo guidelines for marketing and compliance. If that works, Marcus: can your team handle code issuance and the MOU?

Best,
